selection.rationale: This proposal is the most compact and temporally adjacent to the equalizer window (6403.81s–6410.07s vs equalizer buildup at ~6442s). The three interceptions are all non-replay footage events and the observation query targets whether the final interception (event_000636) initiates forward progression toward the equalizer. This directly addresses the unresolved question of whether the buildup-to-equalizer transition has omitted causal state. Other proposals either rely on replay-flagged VAR footage (interval_01:H1), misattribute team sides (interval_01:H2, H4), or lack interleaved opponent events to support their claimed rhythm (interval_01:H3). Interval_02 proposals are weaker because they span post-equalizer to go-ahead with no verified same-phase linkage and several opposing-team actions.
